topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
response: Beam management strategies such as analog beamforming and power allocation optimization are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations. Narrower beams in higher frequency bands can limit ray spread, changing channel selectivity properties.
reference_context: Context discusses SatCom systems, beamforming, and spectrum sharing. It mentions beam gain, noise power density, and satisfaction indices in geo-multibeam satellite communication.
